lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,694 hero damage a minute, more than 94% of Wraith mid players this patch (43% of the team's). The damage came from Tainted Trident, Mutilator, The Perforator.
Back It Up! at rank 3: 95s base, about 56.5s by the end (41% shorter) from 68 ability haste: Tainted Trident 10, Mutilator 15, The Perforator 15, Alternator 10, Infernum 10, Ortus 8.
17 takedowns (15 kills, 2 assists) fed: Ortus (Limit Breaker).
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Wraith dealt 49,121 hero damage, 43% of their team's, with +242 physical power from items.

Penetration: Tainted Trident 11, The Perforator 8, Alternator 10, Infernum 9, Ortus 5, The Perforator ignores 30%; against The Fey (level 15: about 88 physical armor, 19 after penetration; took 13,913 physical damage from heroes, 85% of all hero damage they took) and TwinBlast (level 16: about 102 physical armor, 29 after penetration; took 18,811 physical damage from heroes, 86% of all hero damage they took) that is about 59% and 57% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Tainted Trident (item): On dealing Physical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s.
Tainted Trident (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Blighted Unit: Deal 3 (+6%)% additional Damage.
Mutilator (item): On Successsful Basic Attacks: Deal 1% of their Max Health as Damage.
The Perforator (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Slows by 10% for 1s.
Alternator (item): Your Alternate Ability deals 15% more damage.
Infernum (item): Damaging Abilities and Basic Attacks: Apply stacks of Kindling to Enemy Units for 2.5s. At 4 stacks, ignite them. Deals 4 (+1.5%)% of their Max Health as Damage over 2s.
Infernum (item): Based on Enemy Bonus Armor: For each point, Cinder deals 0.8% more Damage.
Weald (Eternal): Damaging an Enemy Hero below 30% Health fires 4 (+1 per 30% Bonus Attack Speed) projectiles that each deal 7 (+1 per level) True Damage.
Sustain: 12% omnivamp; 1,464 healing recorded.

Lesson: Wraith's penetration cut through: The Fey took about 59% more physical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 15 their armor was about 88, about 19 after 43 flat + 30% penetration).

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Tainted Trident, Mutilator, The Perforator. Wraith has 2 damaging abilities, and 68 ability haste brought them back 40% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Mutilator, Infernum, Weald.
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 3 effects on one trigger: Mutilator, The Perforator, Infernum. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
Stack (Damage that scales with the target's health): 2 effects on one trigger: Mutilator, Infernum. The more health a target stacks, the more these deal, so health items on the other side fed them.
The Eternal was part of it: Weald (Forage + Wind-Rider) sits on the same trigger as the items (every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 2 of the 4 players Wraith killed built physical armor (Aurora, Dekker). Health items on Aurora, Dekker raised the %-health damage they took. We killed Wraith 2 times.
Copy it? Weald (Forage + Wind-Rider): 49.1% in 424 Wraith midlane games, above the hero's 47.4%. Proven this patch: worth copying.
